MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

2. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

3. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

4. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 8
   C. 5
   D. 16

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 46
   C. 30
   D. 23

6. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

7. Solve for x: x + 5 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 14
   C. 5
   D. 9

8. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

9. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 17

10. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/3

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 14
   C. 10
   D. 2

12. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

13. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 11
   C. 5
   D. 24

14. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

15. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

16. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

17. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

18. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

19. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

20. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

21. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 3
   D. 40

22. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

23. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 26

24. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

25. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1

26. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

27. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

28. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 88
   C. 19
   D. 38

29. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

30. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 48
   C. 2
   D. 14
